intro: Governs working conditions for employees of shops, restaurants, hotels, theatres and other commercial establishments in Tamil Nadu. Overview of key points — check current rules, as the state has amended them several times and the national labour codes now overlap.

sections.p: Shops and establishments must register (or be covered by an intimation) with the Labour Department, now done online through the Tamil Nadu Labour Department portal.
Employees can work up to 8 hours a day and 48 hours a week, with rest intervals. Overtime must be paid at twice the ordinary wage.
Every employee gets a weekly holiday with wages, plus annual paid leave, casual leave and sick leave as set by the law.
Tamil Nadu permits shops and establishments to stay open 24 hours on all days, subject to conditions such as giving employees weekly holidays and limiting their hours.
Women can work night shifts with their written consent, and the employer must provide safety, transport and other protections.
A 2021 amendment requires employers to provide seating for employees, so shop staff aren't made to stand throughout their shift.
An employee with at least 6 months' service can't be dismissed without a month's notice or wages in lieu, except for misconduct after inquiry. Employees can appeal against dismissal.
